replacements.Best-of-N: generar múltiples respuestas: Best-of-N: generate multiple answers and choose the best
replacements.La palanca más simple de test-time compu: The simplest test-time compute lever: more independent attempts, a better expected result. Three variants use different selection criteria.
replacements.Mismo prompt, N ejecuciones independient: Same prompt, N independent runs with temperature > 0. The selection criterion determines the variant.
replacements.\"Demuestra que la suma de los ángulos d: "Prove that the sum of a triangle's angles is 180°"
replacements.\"Traza una recta paralela al lado BC po: "Draw a line through vertex A parallel to side BC. Alternate interior angles give α = α', β = β'. The full straight line is 180°, so α + β + γ = 180°."
replacements.\"Considera la suma de los ángulos exter: "Consider the sum of the exterior angles, which is always 360°. Since each exterior angle + interior angle = 180°, for the three vertices: 3×180° - (α+β+γ) = 360°, so α+β+γ = 180°."
replacements.\"Por el postulado de Euclides, en geome: "By Euclid's postulate, in plane geometry the sum of the interior angles of any n-sided polygon is (n-2)×180°. For n=3, the result is 180°."
replacements.→ Candidato 1 seleccionado por mayor pun: → Candidate 1 selected for the highest average score across intermediate steps
replacements.El criterio de selección define la varia: The selection criterion defines the variant. Each has different advantages depending on the domain.
replacements.Un ORM o PRM puntúa cada candidato. Se s: An ORM or PRM scores each candidate. The highest-scoring candidate is selected.
replacements.matemáticas y código donde hay un verifi: mathematics and code where an objective verifier is available.
replacements.Se genera N respuestas y se selecciona l: N answers are generated and the one that appears most often is selected (majority vote over the result, not the reasoning chain).
replacements.preguntas con respuesta discreta (múltip: questions with a discrete answer (multiple choice, calculations with a single result).
replacements.Un modelo separado (o el mismo, en un ro: A separate model (or the same model in a different role) evaluates the candidates and selects the best according to criteria stated in the judge prompt.
replacements.texto abierto, argumentación, análisis —: open-ended text, argumentation, analysis — where there is no objective verifier.
replacements.El rendimiento mejora con N de forma sub: Performance improves with N sublogarithmically. The first candidates add a lot; later candidates add progressively less.
replacements.Pasar de N=1 a N=4 da el mayor salto. De: Moving from N=1 to N=4 gives the largest jump. Moving from N=32 to N=64 adds much less at twice the cost.
replacements.Con PRM el techo es más alto porque el v: With a PRM the ceiling is higher because the verifier can identify the best answer even when it is not the most frequent.
replacements.Para la mayoría de aplicaciones, N entre: For most applications, N between 8 and 32 gives the best performance/cost ratio. Beyond that, cost grows linearly while the benefit plateaus.
